Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Write down the date and time on your computer clock just before step 1.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C154791 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154791-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save.
